experiment: 2026Q4 confidence shock with wage-tax-only fiscal closure

passing_the_buck_scenario.financing_rule: every modeled primary deficit, cash interest cost, and maturing principal is financed through the existing Treasury cohort engine
passing_the_buck_scenario.interpretation_of_indefinitely: through the final supported CBO quarter; no extrapolation beyond 2056Q3

primary_deficits: unchanged nominal baseline before solved adjustment
selected_closure: permanent employee-side surcharge on all wages and salaries
tax_translation: static required primary-balance improvement divided by the CBO 2026-2036 wages-and-salaries share; no behavioral or incidence adjustment
